_comment: R6 (#95) canonical: the sewer_nest_snag trap placement (sewers, 7,3), proving the shipped requires_skill disarm shape live on a NEW world-flavor trap. Loads near_sewers_trap (tactician:1 for the observe tell + rogue:5 for the disarm, positioned at 2,4). Flow: approach -> plain E-interact shows the observe TELL (skill_hint_toast, since the PC already knows [Observe]) -> THE AVOIDABLE PATH proof (walk past the trap's column without disarming, zero side effects) -> return and cast [Appraise Foe] via the field hotbar, the LIVE disarm leg (the merge applied the disarm_trap swap; fixture carries rogue:5 for the leg), banking the shared trap_disarmed counter + 1g salvage. No combat in this script; rng_state is cosmetic (fixture's own TRAP comment).

steps._comment: Down 1 selects Continue, confirm loads the near_sewers_trap fixture.
== APPROACH == row y4 (missing_recruit_loop's own clear corridor), right 5 to (7,4), facing the trap at (7,3).
Up 1 bumps the trap's own occupied cell (7,3) -- stays at (7,4), now facing it.

== THE OBSERVE TELL == plain E-interact. The PC knows [Observe] (tactician:1), so interact()'s requires_skill branch takes the KNOWN arm: a narrative nudge toast (skill_hint_toast), never an auto-disarm (the explicit-hotbar ruling).
steps.name: interact

payload_contains.text: Wire, taut and low, strung off a rusted stanchion. Careful hands could clear it.

steps._comment: == THE AVOIDABLE PATH == the informed-consent counterplay: walk past the trap's own column without ever disarming it. Right 1 to (8,4) -- open floor, no block, no side effect. Zero accomplishment/gold change from this leg.
== RETURN TO DISARM == left 1 back to (7,4), up 1 re-bumps the trap (still facing it, no move).

== THE DISARM LEG ([Disarm Trap], LIVE post-merge) == field-cast disarm_trap via the hotbar (fixture carries rogue:5); routes through the generic requires_skill dispatch, banking trap_disarmed + the 1g salvage. Non-Rogues route around (the avoidable-path leg above) -- the merge-time swap per the controller ruling; the staging swap doc is retired.

payload_contains.text: You ease the wire off its catch and coil it loose. A few scavenged links clatter free, worth a coin or two melted down.
